<p><strong>Managerial problem:</strong> Determine which marketing channels are driving website traffic and how media budget should be allocated more efficiently.</p>
<p><strong>Methods:</strong> Exploratory analysis, correlation review, linear regression, channel comparison, and ROI-focused interpretation.</p>
<p><strong>Business impact:</strong> Supports smarter budget allocation by identifying high-performing channels and areas of inefficient spend.</p>
